_provenance.what: Candidate working point of the Longquanshan delivery chain with the PER-TAG QUANTILE form of the discriminative candidate gate, wired in but DISABLED.  The frozen delivery file (manu/evaluation/system_sota_longquan_delivery_params.json) is untouched; this is a new file.
_provenance.source: manu/evaluation/system_sota_longquan_delivery_params.json -- the 'params' block is copied verbatim (every frozen value is byte-identical, only the new 'cand_gate' key was added) -- plus the out-of-sample sweep manu/evaluation/sweep_decision_layer.py (decision_sweep/20261105_093017_k2k3_oos, sum_quantile_scope=exclude-primary).
_provenance.usage: python manu/evaluation/system_sota_longquan.py --params-json <this file> --seqs <pool> ...  The behaviour is identical to the frozen file while cand_gate.enabled is false.

cand_gate.what: A per-candidate predicate applied to the candidates that survived the cross-scale de-duplication (gate_stage=post): area >= area_min AND sums >= threshold(tag) AND tag in tag_allow.
cand_gate.form: sum_mode='tagq': the floor is a per-tag quantile level of the 'sums' distribution; the resolved per-tag values are frozen in params.cand_gate.thresholds and are NOT recomputed at runtime.
cand_gate.how_the_threshold_was_chosen: The quantile level was re-selected OUT OF SAMPLE (the blind hold-out is excluded from the population that defines the threshold).  The level that was picked inside the sample (q0.2 for trial_0049) fails out of sample and breaks the T2 hard gate, so it was discarded; q0.05 is the level that survives on the reference arm.
cand_gate.status: EXPLORATORY EVIDENCE -- NOT RELEASED, NOT ONLINE, NOT A DELIVERY

measured_out_of_sample.note: area_min=1, tag_allow=[0,1,2], th_base=0.30 (frozen), gate_stage=post, quantile level re-selected out of sample.  'T2 hard gate' = F1 >= 0.985 and FP <= 112 on the golden pool.

cs_t0008p2_tagq_q0.10_post.note: the p2 arm needs its own table and its own level; the equivalent thresholds of the p2 golden pool are tag0=20.160724, tag1=9.923620, tag2=22.585932 at q0.10

evidence.status_of_the_whole_result: Choosing WHICH quantile level to use was still done on the evaluation pools, so the evidence as a whole remains EXPLORATORY.  The gate ships disabled and is not a delivery.

_provenance.note: The frozen delivery configuration is a separate file and was NOT edited in place.  This file is a new working point.  While cand_gate.enabled is false the pipeline is bit-identical to the frozen chain.

cand_gate.threshold_scope: golden pool only (the 7 Longquanshan golden sequences of the reference arm trial_0049); the blind hold-out VIDEO00007_19700101_001324 is excluded from the quantile population (out-of-sample measurement)
